releaseNotes: v1.1.4: Quieter after a hub reboot. The hub's MQTT broker often starts a little after the integration, which logged a warning to run Force Reconnect even though the Bridge connects on its own. Now, for the first 5 minutes after startup it waits quietly, warns only if it still can't connect after that, and skips refreshes asked for while it's connecting, since every remote refreshes once connected. No Done needed. v1.1.3: Lighter on the hub. The Bridge no longer pauses after every MQTT message (the X2's spacing is kept with a timer), the Remote's last-message time updates at most once a minute, activity syncs read each Activity once, and a reconnect only re-reads the activity list. Nothing changes in how Sofabaton works. No Done needed. v1.1.2: Dark mode. The app follows the hub's light or dark theme (Hubitat 2.5.3+) and keeps its current look on older firmware. No Done needed.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Sofabaton Integration
apps.description: Manages one or more Sofabaton X1S or X2 hubs: activities as switches, X2 remote buttons with Button Actions, and setup guides and troubleshooting in one place.

drivers.name: Sofabaton Integration Bridge
drivers.description: Created automatically by the app. Holds the shared MQTT connection for X2 hubs and groups each hub's devices together.

drivers.name: Sofabaton Remote
drivers.description: One per Sofabaton hub, created by the app. Tracks activity changes and fires button events (X2 Hubitat Control commands, X1S IP control). X1S receive path forked from dJOS's Sofabaton X Series driver, see the driver header for credits.

drivers.name: Sofabaton Activity
drivers.description: One per Sofabaton activity, as a switch, created by the app. Starts and stops the activity locally over MQTT (X2) or through Sofabaton's cloud webhook (X1S).
